items.Sentence: Wastewater treatment unit operations and processes at the EWPCF consist of bar screening, peroxide addition, grit removal, primary sedimentation, biological treatment using activated sludge, and secondary clarification.

The EWPCF also has disinfection (chlorination) capabilities limited to the capacity necessary to disinfect secondary-treated effluent currently reused onsite at the EWPCF.
Solids treatment unit operations and processes consist of dissolved air flotation (DAF) thickening, anaerobic digestion, mechanical dewatering (centrifuges), and heat drying.
